content: Hi how can i assist you today
My thermostat shows the fan icon right when I think 'fresh air'.
Fan icons often reflect humidity thresholds, schedules, or filter cycles. Was it near a scheduled circulation window?
It was around the top of the hour, which I set for air cycles.
A top-of-hour schedule would produce that timing.
On days I disable scheduling, it rarely shows up.
That difference supports a rules-based trigger.
So the icon is following the schedule, not my thought.
That’s how these systems typically behave.
